purpose: Labeling target for the independent held-out evaluation set required by Signal MD Final Execution Plan 2, section 14.1. Not a gate input: the release gate loads only top-level .json files directly in tests/fixtures/heldout/. A scenario graduates into a gate fixture only after a qualified reviewer labels 3-5 candidates for it.

targets.reviewerRule: labeler must not be the person who tuned the ranker; two labelers per scenario with adjudication of disagreements
targets.graduationRule: 3+ candidates judged and disagreements adjudicated -> copy into a top-level heldout fixture with split 'heldout' and full provenance

watchFor: issuing-body initials read as the condition
scenarios.guidance: Coronary guideline or landmark ACS trial is on-topic. Cancer-screening intervals and fasciotomy advice are off-topic; any ACS-initials source that is not about the condition is adjacent at best.

watchFor: general adult asthma guidance with no pregnancy applicability
pregnancy drug-safety papers that are not asthma treatment
scenarios.guidance: On-topic requires both asthma treatment AND pregnancy applicability. General adult guidance is adjacent unless it explicitly covers pregnancy.

watchFor: porphyria cutanea tarda (different disease, shared word)
case reports presented as if evidence
scenarios.guidance: On-topic is treatment of acute neurovisceral attacks. Cutaneous porphyrias are adjacent. Expect sparse evidence: an explicit empty landmark lane is a correct outcome, not a defect.

scenarios.query: anticoagulation for atrial fibrillation in chronic kidney disease
scenarios.intendedSense: stroke-prevention anticoagulation choices in AF with renal impairment
scenarios.guidance: On-topic must address both AF anticoagulation AND CKD. Single-disease guidance is adjacent. Divergent guideline positions are both on-topic; disagreement should be visible, not resolved by ranking.

scenarios.query: treatment of post-exertional malaise in ME/CFS
scenarios.intendedSense: myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome symptom management
watchFor: graded exercise papers (contested, should not silently dominate)
scenarios.guidance: Expect weak or contested evidence. A guidelines lane that says no verified current guideline is registered is a correct empty state. Judge abstention, not filler.

scenarios.intendedSense: adjunctive corticosteroids for septic shock per current guidance
watchFor: sepsis guidelines that predate the current corticosteroid evidence
scenarios.guidance: Current guidelines condition steroids on refractory shock. Landmark trials (ADRENAL, APROCCHSS) are on-topic. Superseded editions must be labelled as such in results.

watchFor: insipidus case reports without treatment content
scenarios.guidance: Diabetes mellitus treatment papers are the canonical near-miss: they share the head noun and must not appear as on-topic. Desmopressin and nephrogenic workups are on-topic.
Physical-examination teaching papers are off-topic. D-dimer, YEARS/Wells, CTPA content is on-topic. The resolver should disclose the assumed sense.

watchFor: adult appendicitis pathways (adjacent unless they include children)
pediatric abdominal pain papers that are not appendicitis
scenarios.guidance: On-topic needs both pediatric population and appendicitis diagnosis. Adult pathways are adjacent.
VWF antigen/activity testing guidance is on-topic. Acquired VWS is adjacent. Expect guidelines to dominate the lane.

scenarios.query: investigating suspected stable angina in women
scenarios.intendedSense: diagnostic strategy for stable coronary disease, sex-specific evidence
watchFor: non-invasive test papers ignoring sex differences
scenarios.guidance: On-topic is diagnostic strategy acknowledging atypical presentation in women. Conflicting guideline positions are both on-topic.

scenarios.query: diagnostic test for chronic fatigue syndrome
watchFor: biomarker studies presented as established tests
scenarios.guidance: There is no validated diagnostic test; criteria-based diagnosis is on-topic. A claim of a definitive biomarker test should be treated as unsupported.

scenarios.intendedSense: prediabetes diagnostic thresholds per current criteria
watchFor: older fasting-glucose-only criteria presented as current
HbA1c thresholds that changed between editions
scenarios.guidance: Current WHO/ADA criteria are on-topic. Superseded threshold tables are off-topic unless labelled as historical.

watchFor: TIA as an acronym expansion outside stroke medicine
mimics papers (on-topic if about TIA differentiation)
scenarios.guidance: On-topic is TIA recognition, ABCD2/imaging-based assessment, mimics. Materials using TIA for another expansion are off-topic.
MS must resolve to multiple sclerosis. Cardiac mitral stenosis prognosis is the main collision and is off-topic. The resolver should disclose the assumed sense.
On-topic needs both pregnancy and breast cancer prognosis. Adjuvant-therapy-during-pregnancy papers are on-topic; fertility/future-pregnancy papers are adjacent.

scenarios.intendedSense: IPF natural history and prognostic factors
watchFor: IPF treatment papers without prognostic content
scenarios.guidance: Prognostic factors (FVC decline, GAP index) are on-topic. Treatment trials are adjacent unless they report prognostic endpoints.

scenarios.intendedSense: early stroke risk after transient ischemic attack
watchFor: ABCD2-era guidance vs imaging-and-specialist-assessment guidance (both on-topic)
stroke prognosis papers that are not post-TIA
scenarios.guidance: Conflicting risk-stratification approaches are both on-topic. The result should show the disagreement rather than pick one silently.

watchFor: symptom-cluster papers presented as settled prognosis
scenarios.guidance: Expect heterogeneous and evolving evidence. Explicit uncertainty in the result is correct; confident prognostic claims from small cohorts should be flagged as limited support.

scenarios.query: HIV prognosis before and after modern ART
scenarios.guidance: Era-comparison cohort studies are on-topic. Anything presenting pre-ART prognosis as current care is off-topic.

scenarios.intendedSense: aortic valve stenosis progression and outcomes
scenarios.guidance: AS here is the valve disease. Ankylosing spondylitis material must be excluded; aortic sclerosis natural history is adjacent.

watchFor: DVT treatment papers (adjacent; prevention is prophylaxis)
scenarios.guidance: Prophylaxis guidance is on-topic; treatment of established DVT is adjacent.

scenarios.query: aspirin for primary prevention in adults over 70
watchFor: secondary-prevention aspirin papers (off-topic for primary prevention)
trials excluding the elderly presented as elderly evidence
scenarios.guidance: ASPREE-era evidence in older adults is on-topic. Secondary prevention trials are off-topic for this query.

scenarios.intendedSense: anticoagulation prevention of venous thromboembolism in nephrotic syndrome
watchFor: nephrotic syndrome treatment without thrombosis prevention
scenarios.guidance: On-topic needs both nephrotic syndrome and VTE prevention. Expect guideline-level evidence to be thin; expert guidance counts as on-topic.

scenarios.query: aspirin for primary prevention of cardiovascular disease
watchFor: USPSTF, ESC and ADA positions diverge (all on-topic)
scenarios.guidance: This is the canonical conflicting-guidelines case: divergent recommendations must all be visible.

scenarios.intendedSense: T1D primary prevention or delay of onset
watchFor: type 2 diabetes prevention (the near miss, off-topic)
scenarios.guidance: T1D-specific prevention/delay evidence is on-topic; T2D prevention programs are off-topic despite shared head noun.

scenarios.query: hormone therapy for cardiovascular prevention in postmenopausal women
scenarios.intendedSense: current position on HRT for CV prevention
watchFor: pre-WHI guidance recommending HRT for prevention (off-topic as current advice)
current guidance on HRT for vasomotor symptoms (adjacent)
scenarios.guidance: Current guidance does not recommend HRT for CV prevention. WHI-era reanalysis is on-topic as evidence; outdated recommendations must not be presented as current.

watchFor: AF rate/rhythm control without stroke content
scenarios.guidance: On-topic is anticoagulation/bleeding-risk content for AF. Generic secondary stroke prevention is adjacent.
On-target TKI cardiotoxicity (hypertension, QT, heart failure) is on-topic. Other drug classes' cardiotoxicity are adjacent.

scenarios.query: statin adverse effects in older adults
scenarios.intendedSense: statin intolerance and adverse events, elderly
watchFor: adult statin trials excluding the elderly
scenarios.guidance: On-topic needs adverse-effect evidence in or applicable to older adults. Trials excluding over-75s are adjacent.
On-topic is clozapine-specific myocarditis. Monitoring-protocol papers are on-topic; other drug-induced myocarditis is adjacent.

watchFor: POISE-era harm signal vs continuation guidance (both on-topic)
scenarios.guidance: Continuation and initiation are different questions; guidance that conflates them is a defect. Divergent positions are both on-topic.

scenarios.query: long-term adverse effects of proton pump inhibitors
scenarios.guidance: Expect observational evidence with confounding; judge how claims are framed. Overstated causal claims are a labeling flag (unsupported material claim).

watchFor: rofecoxib-era data presented as class-wide current verdict
scenarios.guidance: Class history is on-topic as evidence; a result presenting the 2004 verdict as current without PRECISION-era nuance is outdated.

watchFor: the known AKI near-miss: oncology toxicity papers crowding out AKI consensus
scenarios.guidance: This query is the historical AKI contamination case in reverse: nephrology consensus is on-topic; non-renal toxicity reviews are adjacent.

scenarios.intendedSense: acute kidney injury biomarker evidence quality
watchFor: AKI as initials of another body or condition
scenarios.guidance: ADQI biomarker consensus is on-topic. Off-topic: oncology immunotherapy-toxicity papers (the historical contamination).

scenarios.query: evidence for tight glycemic control in the ICU
scenarios.intendedSense: intensive vs conventional glucose control, critically ill
watchFor: NICE-SUGAR harm signal vs older single-centre benefit trials (both on-topic)
scenarios.guidance: Landmark ICU trials are on-topic; ward-based glycemia is adjacent.

watchFor: small case series presented as definitive
scenarios.guidance: Pneumatic dilation, POEM, Heller outcomes are on-topic. Evidence will be sparse and low-certainty; explicit certainty handling is expected.

scenarios.query: evidence on salt reduction and cardiovascular outcomes
scenarios.intendedSense: dietary sodium and CV outcomes, contested evidence
watchFor: both directions of the sodium debate are on-topic
scenarios.guidance: Contested evidence must surface both positions; guideline-vs-cohort disagreement is the point of this scenario.

scenarios.query: evidence summary of interventions for long COVID
watchFor: single small trials presented as established practice
scenarios.guidance: Living reviews and WHO/NIH position statements are on-topic. An honest 'evidence is limited' summary is the expected good outcome.

scenarios.query: evidence on postmenopausal hormone therapy and cognition
scenarios.intendedSense: HRT cognitive effects, WHI-era to current
watchFor: WHI memory findings presented without timing hypothesis
scenarios.guidance: Era-structured evidence (WHI WHIMS vs later timing-hypothesis analyses) is on-topic; outdated one-sided summaries are a defect.

scenarios.intendedSense: acute kidney injury definition criteria evidence
watchFor: acute kidney disease (AKD) vs AKI confusion (adjacent)
scenarios.guidance: KDIGO-era definition evidence is on-topic; AKD (a distinct entity) material is adjacent and must not dominate.
